subject: Cloud Computing
title: Platform Engineering Takes Over
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Platform Engineering Takes Over.

hook.text: DevOps gave developers freedom. Too much freedom. Platform engineering builds golden paths that make the right way easy.

buildup.text: Developers don't want to learn Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines. They want to push code and have it run.

discovery.text: Internal Developer Platforms abstract away infrastructure. Backstage, Humanitec, and Port build self-service portals.

twist.text: Platform engineering doesn't replace DevOps. It's the next step — making DevOps practices accessible to all developers.

climax.text: Gartner predicts 80% of large companies will have platform teams by 2026. The platform engineer is the new key role.

punchline.text: Golden paths, not gatekeepers. Platform engineering simplifies DevOps.

quiz.question: What problem does platform engineering solve?
options: It simplifies cloud complexity by providing self-service golden paths for developers
It eliminates the need for any cloud infrastructure
It replaces developers with automated systems

details.summary: Platform engineering creates internal developer platforms that abstract cloud complexity, providing golden paths for common tasks like deploying services, provisioning databases, and setting up monitoring. It lets developers self-serve while maintaining organizational standards.
details.whyItMatters: Platform engineering solves the cognitive overload developers face with raw cloud services. It accelerates development while maintaining security, compliance, and operational standards.
takeaways: Internal platforms abstract cloud complexity for developers
Golden paths provide pre-approved patterns for common tasks
Developer self-service improves speed while maintaining standards

faq.question: How does platform engineering differ from DevOps?
faq.answer: DevOps expects developers to manage their own infrastructure. Platform engineering builds a product, an internal developer platform, that handles infrastructure complexity for developers. It recognizes that not every developer should need to understand Kubernetes, networking, and security in depth.

faq.question: What tools support platform engineering?
faq.answer: Backstage by Spotify provides developer portal frameworks. Humanitec and Kratix offer platform orchestration. Crossplane extends Kubernetes for infrastructure management. These tools help platform teams build self-service interfaces that enforce organizational standards.
